194:t_1:87.en:
$$ランカ$$
「...I'm sorry. I'm just... a little tired...」

194:t_1:88.en:
$$シェリル$$
「No wonder. But don't give up hope.」

194:t_1:89.en:
$$シェリル$$
「Because your song is everyone's hope.」

194:t_1:92.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「...Hmph. Still wearing that gloomy face, I see.」

194:t_1:93.en:
$$シェリル$$
「Do you really think I can smile in a situation like this?」

194:t_1:94.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「You two... I hear you're famous singers.」

194:t_1:95.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Since you're here, go ahead and sing something.」

194:t_1:96.en:
$$シェリル$$
「Sorry to disappoint. We're professionals.」

194:t_1:97.en:
$$シェリル$$
「I don't know any songs to sing for no pay, let alone for invaders.」

194:t_1:101.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「I heard this planet still had songs, so I was looking forward to it...」

194:t_1:102.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Damn... If we weren't on duty, we could have gone to that live show...」

194:t_1:104.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「They say some singers from Earth are coming to this city.」

194:t_1:105.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Apparently they're a bunch called $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$.」

194:t_1:106.en:
$$シェリル$$
「$$熱気バサラ$$ is coming...!」

194:t_1:110.en: ～ $$ネオ・アルカトラズ$$ Live Venue ～

194:t_1:111.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Woooah! Hurry up and let us hear it!!」

194:t_1:114.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「I had my doubts, but Major $$オズマ$$ called it.」

194:t_1:115.en:
$$ミーナ#pt251$$
「So it's true that $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$ is a huge hit in the Empire.」

194:t_1:116.en:
$$カナリア$$
「Per a report from Major $$カリーニン$$, who is gathering intel, the $$サイデリアル$$, a coalition of people from different stars, apparently has its culture restricted for control.」

194:t_1:117.en:
$$カナリア$$
「As a result they are starved for culture, and the ever-elusive $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$ has apparently become a kind of legend among them.」

194:t_1:118.en:
$$ミーナ#pt251$$
「So it's a situation like the $$ゼントラーディ$$ and the $$ミンメイ$$ Shock.」

194:t_1:119.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Well, nobody can stop the overwhelming excitement of this many people.」

194:t_1:120.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Even the higher-ups in the $$サイデリアル$$ will have no choice but to turn a blind eye to this.」

194:t_1:121.en:
$$クラン$$
「B-but... no matter what, isn't it a stretch for us to pass as stand-ins...」

194:t_1:122.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Pointed ears and hardly any curves! That's $$ミレーヌ$$ on bass!」

194:t_1:123.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「The dark-skinned keyboard player! Let us hear you, $$レイ・ラブロック$$!」

194:t_1:124.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「The giant woman on drums! What power, $$ビヒーダ$$!」

194:t_1:125.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「And the man with glasses! So that's the famous $$熱気バサラ$$!」

194:t_1:127.en:
$$ミーナ#pt251$$
「The cosplay outfits $$かなめ$$, $$エイミー$$ and I put together seem to have worked, too.」

194:t_1:129.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「The PA will play the backing track for that. Ready, $$ルカ$$?」

194:t_1:130.en:
$$ルカ$$
「Yes. Everyone, please fake it with lip-syncing and miming your playing.」

194:t_1:131.en:
$$クラン$$
「Will that really be all right?」

194:t_1:132.en:
$$ルカ$$
「With this much excitement, we should be able to get away with it to some extent.」

194:t_1:133.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'm counting on you guys... We succeeded in gathering the soldiers here. Now it all comes down to how much time we can buy.」

194:t_1:134.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「I'm counting on you to get the crowd pumped too, Dancer!」

194:t_1:136.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Then let's start the operation... I mean, the live show...!」

194:t_1:138.en:
$$カナリア$$
(Amazing, this roar of cheering...)

194:t_1:139.en:
$$クラン$$
(Now that's truly $$デ・カルチャー$$!)

194:t_1:140.en:
$$ミーナ#pt251$$
(I could get a little hooked on this...)

194:t_1:145.en:
$$オズマ$$
「...The live show should have started by now.」

194:t_1:146.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「Judging by the situation so far, most of the soldiers in town seem to have packed into the venue.」

194:t_1:147.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Major $$オズマ$$'s plan has paid off.」

194:t_1:148.en:
$$オズマ$$
「I know how great $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$ is better than anyone.」

194:t_1:149.en:
$$オズマ$$
(Now we just need the trump card to make it in time...)

194:t_1:150.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「The real thing starts now. Each of you, confirm your part of the operation.」

194:t_1:151.en:
$$スザク$$
「Team A will go straight into the detention facility and free the captured people.」

194:t_1:152.en:
$$マオ$$
「Team B will infiltrate the $$ターミナル・ベース$$ and gather as much information as possible.」

194:t_1:153.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Team C will provide a diversion, depending on the situation.」

194:t_1:154.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$ラルク$$... Our trump cards on this side are you and $n. I'm counting on you.」

194:t_1:155.en:
$n
「Roger. When the time comes, I'll summon $$ジェニオン$$ and go wild.」

194:t_1:156.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Come on! Big Sis, say a cool catchphrase like $n's too!」

194:t_1:157.en:
$$ラルク$$
「...I understand the mission. What I can't accept is that you're coming along.」

194:t_1:158.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「It can't be helped. Before we knew it, she had followed us.」

194:t_1:159.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Her superhuman strength might come in handy for something. Don't be so harsh on her, $$ラルク$$.」

194:t_1:160.en:
$$ノノ$$
「That's right, Big Sis! At times like this, let's make the mission a success with hard work and guts!」

194:t_1:161.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I'll do the mission without being told. Hard work and guts have nothing to do with it.」

194:t_1:164.en:
$$タケル$$
「Are you all right, $$ラルク$$!」

194:t_1:166.en:
???
「Heh heh heh... A little girl like that is your trump card?」

194:t_1:169.en:
$$ギルター$$
「That's right. This is the first time we've met face to face, $c.」

194:t_1:170.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「$$ラルク$$! Withdraw from here with $$ノノ$$ and carry out the operation!」

ミンメイ.evidence: Lynn Minmay of Macross; used alone in ミンメイ・ショック (Minmay Shock); no bare-name token in the sheet (only リン・ミンメイ)
